title: Joining Sidney Desvigne and the band personnel
summary: After picnics and bars he joined Desvigne after 10-15 years of playing; he names the members.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And played at different little picnics. I played a lot of picnics. And I finally joined up with Sidney Desvene Band.
How long had you played before you joined Sidney?
I had been playing, I'd say about 10 years. Between 10 and 15 years before I joined Sidney's band.
Who else was in his band when he...

Alvin Alcorn. We had Alvin Alcorn on trumpet. Had Sidney on trumpet. Joe Phillips was on trumpet. Louis Cottrell, the president, was playing tenor. Sam Lee, he was on tenor. And we had Jerry Green, he was playing bass. We had Oscar Ruzon. He was an alto man. And we had myself, I was on drums. And we had Buddy Charles, William Charles, he was playing guitar. And Raymond Anker was a singer and director of the band at the time. And they had a wonderful band.
